title: Grateful Dead Live at Saenger Performing Arts Center on 1982-09-09
source: flac16/48kHz; Source Info: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B) > Dat (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony PCM-R500)> Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/48k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac1648; the original version had a duplicate "Space" ("Drums > Space" were 1 track, followed by "Space" again)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording plagued by pitch‑speed issues yet captures a solid ’82 New Orleans show highlighted by an “awful good” Wheel performance.
ai_review.review: The SBD source is technically compromised – it runs several percent fast, needs extensive pitch correction and has a brief dropout in Space. Musically the concert is uneven: a shaky first set with a muffed Mississippi Half‑Step and an abrupt Althea exit, but the second set builds momentum with a hot Estimated Prophet jam, a monster Wheel, and a classic Good Lovin' ending.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review gives an overall 3‑star rating; the show has notable high points but is marred by performance slips and significant recording pitch problems.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch runs ~2–3 % fast across most tracks, requiring multiple percentage adjustments; balance needs fixing; brief dropout at start of Space; overall clarity is decent but speed/pitch issues dominate.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set feels tentative and ends abruptly when Bob quits Althea; second set recovers with strong tempos, extended jams, and a soaring Wheel before a double encore featuring Day Job.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Muffed Mississippi Half‑Step, added extra parts on Franklin's Tower, dropped a solo in West L.A., took rhythm lead after Bob left the stage.
band_member_comments.Bob: Abruptly exited during Althea due to equipment problems, returning briefly later.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland steps forward on keyboards, leading the band through the second set and encore.
